title: Ferrox Sentinel Edge Shield, CSP Directives & Payload Bouncer
description: The ferrox-sentinel crate is the edge security bouncer for the Ferrox framework. It delivers automated HTTP security headers (Helmet CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options), CORS origin regex validation, payload size bouncers, and malicious request parameter sanitization.
